title: 第7章 通过第8章 有种打一场
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
画面中，秦宇看到那穷凶极恶的妖怪后，与众人反应一致，转身就跑。
但还没跑两步，妖怪直接一个跳跃蹦到秦宇身后，一口咬住秦宇的背包。
二长老暂停了画面，有些诧异道：
“怎么回事，剧情不是这样的啊？”
“幻梦犬应该先在后边徘徊一会儿，等小辈们跑到小女孩那个位置，才加速冲过来。”
“这只幻梦犬出手也太早了吧！”
小女孩都还没出来，怎么判断此人心性。
大长老说道：“老二，是不是你没跟这只幻梦犬讲清楚规则？”
毕竟这次有三百多只幻梦犬参加，总有没听明白规则的幻梦犬。
“不可能啊，我与幻梦犬族长一起演习过好多次。”
“而且这只幻梦犬负责的其他几人，也没有出现过这种情况。”
三长老说道：“既然不是幻梦犬的问题，那肯定就是人的问题。”
“而且你们发现没，这个少年身后竟然背着背包。”
幻梦犬创造的幻境并非纯粹的幻境，而是现实的映射。
在将人拉入幻境时，它可以选择只拉这个人，也可以选择将这人和和他身上的物一并拉入幻境中。
所以，秦宇在幻境中，依旧背着背包。
但令众长老疑惑的是，其他小辈都没有携带随身物品，为什么唯独此人有个背包。
“莫非是这背包的问题？先看一下接下来的画面吧！”
画面开始变化。
背包被咬住，秦宇直接金蝉脱壳，把背包一摘便逃窜出去。

但秦宇很快发现，妖怪并没有跟上来。
秦宇好奇回头，发现妖怪正用爪子扒拉着他的背包。
稍一用力，秦宇的背包便被撕成两半。
红色的裤衩、打着补丁的衣服洒落一地。
同时，一个用黄纸包裹的皱皱巴巴的东西也落到地上。
“噢~”
妖怪似乎是看到了自己喜欢的东西，欢快的叫了一声。
随即，妖怪的身形迅速缩小，最后变成了一只毛茸茸的小黑狗，爪子上有一撮白毛，像是带着小巧的白手套，额头上有着一个月牙形的标志，背上有着两个卡通翅膀花纹，看上去萌萌哒。
小黑狗欢快的跳到那一坨黄纸包裹的不明之物面前，大快朵颐起来。
秦宇此刻是懵逼的，暂时丧失记忆的他并不知道自己身上的背包是哪来的。
也忘记了那黄纸中包的是他祖传秘方制作的臭豆腐。
他现在只感觉这小黑狗好可爱，好想撸一把！
宗门大殿中。
宗主和各大长老此刻也是懵逼的。
他们明白幻梦犬之所以如此反常，是因为那黄纸包裹的不明物体。
只是...
那黄纸中包裹的到底是什么，为何有如此魔力，竟然对幻梦犬有如此大的吸引力？
“幻梦犬身为神兽，对灵植和灵药极其敏感，莫非那黄纸中包裹的是某种灵植或灵药？”
三长老猜测道。
“应该不是！”

宗主说道：“我玄天宗什么灵植灵药没有，这些幻梦犬每天也是灵植灵药供着，寻常的灵植灵药绝对不会对他们有如此吸引力。”
“若是那些极其罕见的天材地宝，必然会带着灵气波动，没道理幻梦犬能察觉，而我等察觉不到。”
大长老点点头，附和道：“看那黄纸中包裹的东西，也不像天材地宝的样子。”
二长老若有所思，“那还有什么东西能够对幻梦犬有如此大的诱惑呢？”
“实际上还真有一种东西，对幻梦犬的诱惑比天材地宝还大。”
content_en:
In the picture, after Qin Yu saw the vicious monster, he reacted in the same way as everyone else, turned around and ran away.
But before he could take two steps, the monster jumped directly behind Qin Yu and bit Qin Yu's backpack.
The second elder paused the screen and said with some surprise:
"What's going on? That's not the plot?"
"The Dream Dog should linger behind for a while, wait for the juniors to reach the little girl's position, and then speed up and rush over."
"It's too early for this dream dog to take action!"
The little girl hasn't come out yet, how can we judge this person's character?
The great elder said: "Second brother, did you fail to explain the rules clearly to this dream dog?"
After all, there are more than 300 Dream Dogs participating this time, and there are always some Dream Dogs who don't understand the rules.
"It's impossible. I've practiced it many times with the Dream Dog Clan Leader."
"And this has never happened to the other people responsible for this dream dog."
The third elder said: "Since it's not the Dream Dog's problem, it must be the people's problem."
"And have you noticed that this boy is carrying a backpack behind him?"
The illusion created by the Dream Dog is not a pure illusion, but a reflection of reality.
When pulling a person into the illusion, it can choose to pull only the person, or it can choose to pull the person and the objects on him into the illusion.
Therefore, Qin Yu was still carrying a backpack in the illusion.
But what puzzled the elders was that none of the other juniors carried any personal belongings, so why was this person the only one with a backpack.
"Is it a problem with this backpack? Let's take a look at the next scene first!"
The picture begins to change.
When his backpack was bitten, Qin Yu jumped out of his shell, took off his backpack and ran away.
But Qin Yu soon discovered that the monster did not follow.
Qin Yu turned back curiously and found that the monster was pulling at his backpack with its claws.
With a little force, Qin Yu's backpack was torn in half.
Red pants and patched clothes were scattered all over the floor.
At the same time, a crumpled object wrapped in yellow paper fell to the ground.
"Oh~"
The monster seemed to have seen something he liked and screamed happily.
Immediately, the monster's figure quickly shrank, and finally turned into a fluffy little black dog, with a tuft of white hair on its paws, like a small white glove, a crescent-shaped logo on its forehead, and two cartoon wing patterns on its back, which looked cute.
The little black dog happily jumped in front of the unknown object wrapped in yellow paper and started to feast.
Qin Yu was confused at the moment. He had temporarily lost his memory and didn't know where the backpack he was wearing came from.
He also forgot that what was wrapped in the yellow paper was the stinky tofu made from his ancestral secret recipe.
Now he just feels that this little black dog is so cute and wants to stroke it!
In the sect's main hall.
The sect leader and the elders were also confused at this moment.
They understood that the reason why Dream Dog was so abnormal was because of the unknown object wrapped in yellow paper.
Just...
What exactly is wrapped in the yellow paper, and why is it so magical and so attractive to the Dream Dog?
"As a mythical beast, Dream Dog is extremely sensitive to spiritual plants and elixirs. Could it be that the yellow paper wrapped in some kind of spiritual plants or elixirs?"
The third elder guessed.
"Probably not!"
The sect leader said: "Our Xuantian Sect does not have any spiritual plants and elixirs. These dream dogs are provided with spiritual plants and elixirs every day. Ordinary spiritual plants and elixirs will never be so attractive to them."
"If they are extremely rare treasures of heaven and earth, they will definitely have spiritual energy fluctuations. There is no reason that the Dream Dog can detect them, but we can't."
The great elder nodded and agreed: "Looking at the things wrapped in the yellow paper, they don't look like heavenly materials or earthly treasures."
The second elder thought thoughtfully, "Then what else can be so tempting to the Dream Dog?"
"In fact, there is something that is more tempting to the Dream Dog than the treasures of heaven and earth."
